51551921.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human PD-L1 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: Unless otherwise specified, all proteins used in the tests were purchased from Sino Biological Biotech Inc.: human PD-L1 (catalog no. 10084-HNAH) and murine PD-L1 (catalog no. 50010-M08H). The SPR assay was carried out using PlexArray HT. In short, the concentration of h/mPD-L1 was diluted to 0.5 mg/mL with sterile water and it was fixed to a bare gold-plated PlexArray nanosensor chip via an amide bond. Then, SWS1–6 (various concentrations) were injected into the flow cell (30 μL) by a nonpulsatile piston pump.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. Real time interaction between h/mPD-L1 and D-(+)-biotin-conjugated PD-L1 conjugates.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 sensorgram labels: SWS1 Human PD-L1, SWS1 Murine PD-L1, SWS2 Human PD-L1, SWS2 Murine PD-L1, SWS3 Human PD-L1, SWS3 Murine PD-L1, SWS4 Human PD-L1, SWS4 Murine PD-L1, SWS5 Human PD-L1, SWS5 Murine PD-L1, SWS6 Human PD-L1, SWS6 Murine PD-L1, D-(+)-biotin Human PD-L1, D-(+)-biotin Murine PD-L1, SWS1 Human PD-L1 Kd=43.7 nM, SWS1 Murine PD-L1 Kd=217.7 nM
original_paragraph.Figure 4 sensorgram concentration labels: 10 μM, 5 μM, 20 μM, 10 μM, 5 μM, 1 μM, 0.01 μM
original_paragraph.Results section text: As shown in Figure 4, most of the D-(+)-biotin-conjugated PD-L1 inhibitors showed similar binding affinity for h/mPD-L1, while D-(+)-biotin was inactive at concentrations as high as 20 μM. Importantly, SWS1 showed similar binding affinity for hPD-L1 and mPD-L1 with Kd values of 43.7 and 217.7 nM, respectively, suggesting that SWS1 can cross-react with h/mPD-L1 with potent affinity.
